verdict.rationale: Crossplane's first-party install docs show it is deployed with a Helm chart (`helm install crossplane --namespace crossplane-system ...`) into a Kubernetes cluster you run yourself. They also document stable and pre-release channels and feature flags configurable at install time, so the core control plane is self-hostable. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment, explicit open-source licensing or hosting requirements in the evidence.
